title: So, What Do You Do? Talking Business
culturalNote: Kenya runs on small businesses — "biashara" — and almost everyone has one, or a side hustle next to their job. Asking "Biashara iko aje?" (How's business?) is a normal friendly question. Mobile money (M-Pesa) lets customers pay in small amounts, which is how many companies sell solar lamps, phones and fridges to families upcountry. A business person is "mfanyabiashara" — literally "a doer of business".
startingPoint: A networking evening at a hotel in Westlands. A man in a sharp suit holds out his hand.
